status: post-hoc descriptive and secondary-metric diagnostics; fixed before these calculations, after original metric means and primary outcomes were known; not preregistration or a new independent test
purchase_population: Only queries with at least one purchased target, identified by nonmissing saved purchase metrics; missing metrics are inapplicable, never zero. Require identical purchase masks for both metrics, arms and model seeds before and after the fixed exclusions. Report query/user counts and share of main population.
estimand: Mean paired metric difference per eligible query, separately for each model seed. Bootstrap whole users with replacement, retaining all eligible queries of each sampled user; resample statistic is total sampled delta divided by total sampled query count, not an equal-weight mean of user means.

bootstrap.unit: user_id parsed from qid; whole eligible user cluster
bootstrap.rng: numpy.default_rng, freshly initialized per metric and seed
bootstrap.interpretation: Marginal 95% percentile intervals for six planned metric/seed contrasts; not simultaneous confidence coverage, no multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claims, and no noninferiority/equivalence test. No averaged-seed interval or selection of a preferred seed.

main_ndcg_distribution.population: Same primary-test queries as the earlier sensitivity analysis, separately per model seed
main_ndcg_distribution.delta: saved Hp ndcg minus saved base ndcg

categories.unchanged: delta == 0, exact floating equality; does not imply identical ranking

outputs: query count and fraction for each category
positive contribution to overall mean: sum positive / all query count
negative contribution to overall mean: sum negative / all query count
overall mean delta; must equal positive plus negative contributions
unconditional quantiles of all query deltas
main_ndcg_distribution.interpretation: Descriptive per-query distribution, not a fraction of satisfied users or a requirement that most queries improve. Do not select thresholds, trim extremes or change the primary estimand after inspecting results. No inferential claims from these quantiles.

checks: All required input hashes match before and after computation; source code and plan hashes recorded and stable
Each source has unique nonnull qid with parseable date:user_id, and anchor equals qid date
Exact full key sets match across arms and seeds before filtering; never silently intersect keys
Exact date sets match the fixed full and filtered ranges
Primary filtered query count is 97656 and dates count is 14 for each arm/seed
ndcg and recall are nonmissing finite values in [0,1]; purchase metrics may be missing only on the identical inapplicable mask, with all observed values finite in [0,1]
Purchase eligible population is nonempty, identical across arms/seeds and between purchase metrics
Metric means averaged across model seeds reproduce original primary summary within its published rounding tolerance 0.00000501
Main ndcg point deltas and population reproduce previous sensitivity results within 1e-12
Category counts sum to population; fractions sum to one; signed contributions sum to the main mean delta
Result path must be new; exclusive creation refuses overwriting; JSON contains no NaN or Infinity
interpretation_limits: All analyses are post-hoc and use already exposed test outcomes; the original test verdict and criterion remain unchanged
Purchase metrics are conditional on queries with purchased targets and do not measure conversion, revenue, causal business benefit or online effects
User resampling does not jointly account for user and day dependence
Different model seeds do not represent independent runs of the feature-generating agent
Report all six secondary intervals and both distributions in machine-readable results; concise report text may summarize them without hiding disagreements
prohibited: New paid LLM research calls or Kaggle submissions
Changing historical metrics, frozen configurations, logs or previous sensitivity results
Selecting new dates, metrics, thresholds, favorable seed or subpopulation after outcomes
Filling missing purchase metrics with zero
Treating secondary results as a new confirmatory test

amendments_before_computation.reason: Coordinator and implementation owner aligned fixed descriptive quantile grid and added purchase-metric semantics / shared-bootstrap dependency hashes before any new effect or interval was computed.
